namespace PubDV01

def isEven (z : Int) : Prop := ∃ k : Int, z = 2 * k

theorem even_mul_any (a b : Int) (ha : isEven a) : isEven (a * b) := by
  cases ha with
  | intro k hk =>
    refine ⟨k * b, ?_⟩
    rw [hk, Int.mul_assoc]

end PubDV01
